Results.ReviewText: Always solid kooks with the Weber. Also you must get a Weber chimney starter it will make the experience so much better.
Results.Title: Love my webers!

Results.ReviewText: For 36 years the original 22.5" Weber kettle was still going strong but it was time for a shiny new one. We used the old one at least twice a week even in winter for 36 years. Other than the lid handle everything was still in working order. If this one lasts 36 years it will outlive us!
Results.Title: After 36 years it was time for

Results.ReviewText: I wish I'd have gotten the master touch, for the extra money it would've been the better grill, but I still love this thing. I'll never get rid of it even when I get a master touch or performer.
Results.Title: Almost perfect

Results.ReviewText:
Easy... it makes everything easy... grilled medium rare or medium well? EASY!
Assembling the Kettle: EASY!!
The chimney (not included) makes it even EASIER to set the charcoal on fire!
Results.Title: This is the best purchase, EVER!

Results.ReviewText: I've only been able to use it twice. Chicken thighs the first time and hams and hots the second time. Grills great. Holds the temp and no flare ups. It cools down pretty qiuck when you close the vents off.
Results.Title: Grillz Great

Results.ReviewText: Replacement for my 18yr old friend. No complaints about the old one as it was used at least once and sometimes 3 times a week for that period of time. My deck box has 18 bags of charcoal at this time and plan to use it all by next year
Results.Title: 1st was 18yrs old when it gave up the ghost

Results.ReviewText: This grill has brought back my excitement to cook outside again. The quality and versatility are outstanding.
Results.Title: Versatile

Results.ReviewText: My Weber is extremely versatile and gives me great results. I find it difficult now to go back to propane once you taste the flavours you get with charcoal. I wanted to learn to smoke brisket and the Weber was the best and easiest solution I found for that. No regrets at all!
Results.Title: Now I can make brisket every weekend!

Results.ReviewText: Weber grills are the way to cook! Ease of use, easy clean up!
Results.Title: Quality! You get what you pay for top notch materi

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: Impossible de revenir au gaz pour un vrai bon steak à mon goût
Results.Title: Je l'adore

Results.ReviewText: Easy installation instructions.  It maintains a constant temperature with some minor adjustments and cooked my brisket perfectly. Very easy to clean out
Results.Title: Great features

Results.ReviewText: My 2nd. Excellant grill. I do miss two handles. Would buy another
Results.Title: Kettle Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: Premier Weber et premier bbq au charbon. Le goût est incroyable!
Results.Title: Incroyable

Results.ReviewText:
Weber makes the best charcoal grills! 
We enjoy cooking, baby back ribs, steaks, chicken, and much more. 
A quality made product at a fair price
Results.Title: Weber is a quality product at a fair price

Results.ReviewText: Very versatile.  There are many methods that you can use to prepare your food.   The accessories that are available give you several options to cook with your grill.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle Grill  Cooking

Results.ReviewText: Easy setup perfect size for us and our first few uses have proven it distributes and maintains heat well.
Results.Title: As expected this is my grill

Results.ReviewText: Best grill out there and versatile as well. I can smoke a decent size pork loin, or small brisket and even an 8 lb. Chicken without crowding. Plus the ash catcher is a lot easier than the frisbee of old.
Results.Title: One of the most versatile grills ever.

Results.ReviewText: Great design still the classic look love the warranty which is very long covers a lot just wish it would have have came with a cover.
Results.Title: Quality

Results.ReviewText: I have used an Original Kettle Weber Charcoal Grill for over 20 years.  It has always been a good tool for grilling, cooking, smoking.   Very versatile.  Much better flavor with charcoal and smoke than gas.  Plenty of room for what I needed.  Finally stepped up to a "Premium" of the same model this year.
Results.Title: Great Grill !!!

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are so sorry to hear about the legs being damaged on your grill. This is not the quality we expect from our products. Our Support team is reaching out to assist you further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: One leg was impossible to fit to the kettle without destroying it. Bad design/execution on the receiving  kettle bottom. Replacement legs were sent. One of those also was mangled and became useless. On the third try, finally got it to inset all the way in, albeit with bending of the wheel end. I'm sure it will work as advertised, now that all that is over with.
Results.Title: Assembly Problem

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill, easy to assemble, bought Weber cover very durable.
Results.Title: Weber Premium Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: We purchased this grill about a month ago. Assembly was quick and easy to put together.  It is very easy to cook with and was a fun “project” to figure out and play with. We’ve used it three times now and played around with cooking methods and times and we LOVE the results. It’s so good we will be purchasing another one to take to the lake!
Results.Title: My favourite grill

Results.ReviewText: Well made, excellent product.  Looking forward to many years of enjoyment
Results.Title: Solid piece of equipment

Results.ReviewText: Great design and workmanship! This is my 8th Weber.
Results.Title: Awesome grill.  High quality

Results.ReviewText: Bought a month ago and it truly is amazing ! Bought with a chimney and highly recommend them both easy to start and cooks good ! I smoked a salmon on it and it was perfect !
Results.Title: Better then I thought

Results.ReviewText: My third Weber kettle.  Just as good as the original. I season  and inject the  meat, load it on the grill and Let ‘er rip, tater chip. I don’t lift the lid until it is done to perfection. Love my Weber
Results.Title: My kettle

Results.ReviewText:
It's fun to learn a new grill. 

I started with a Smokey Joe in college, then moved "up" to a gas Genesis. I missed the classic charcoal flavor, so my kids got me a kettle. To me, the most importamt feature is the thermometer.
Results.Title: It compliments my gas Genesis

Results.ReviewText: After two uses already have a bent grate which is very disappointing
Results.Title: Overall nice grill but quality is not like The old

Results.ReviewText: Should have put the thermometer on side instead. When using indirect heat thermometer is directly above coals. Other than that this is a fantastic grill.  This is my third Webber grill in the last 25 years. Other two kettle was still perfect but other parts deteriorated.
Results.Title: Thermometer placement

Results.ReviewText: I love the way my steaks come out on this grill. I can’t wait to try out some new accessories.
Results.Title: Pleased

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Charcoal Grill is the ONLY grill I'll use. Lost my original in a move and am thrilled with my new one. With the Weber Charcoal Grill, a home chef can truly cook. That's not my expense with the stainless propane furnaces that deliver zero flavor for $1000+.
Results.Title: A Charcoal Weber: A Griller's Only Choice

Results.ReviewText: This was my first weber and I absolutely love it. I find the heat control and consistency to be next to none. I have owned no name kettles and was always happy with them, but I think that has changed now haha.
Results.Title: Unbelievable heat control!

Results.ReviewText: Wheels were missing from the carton. Service was excellent to send the missing items quickly.
Results.Title: Missing parts

Results.ReviewText: Love the barbecue. From smoking to direct heat this barbecue does it all
Results.Title: Versatile cooker

Results.ReviewText: Weber always makes a quality grill. This model does not disappoint.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Back to charcoal grilling.  So much better flavor than gas grills.  The Weber Premium has everything to make grilling easier.  Only issue is getting the ash pan out is a bit harder than it should be.
Results.Title: Chillin' and Grillin'

Results.ReviewText: Our old 22" Weber was crushed by a tree that fell and I would not replace it with anything else. Easy to assemble. New ash catching feature works wonderfully and really helps to seal the kettle once cooking is complete. Using less charcoal now as well as not as much is needed for a sufficient fire. Well done, Weber!
Results.Title: Excellent quality does not disappoint!

Results.ReviewText:
It's great to have the easy disposal of ashes as well as the flip up grate. 
This makes charcoal grilling super easy, and charcoal is our favorite!
Loved learning about the little firestarter bricks too - I am SOLD.
My old grill had a vent on the top that you could push open and closed with your fingers. I REALLY miss that - it has almost become a muscle memory after 20+ years with that grill and I keep burning my fingers on the new one. guess I'll learn
Results.Title: Kettle Charcoal gril

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback regarding the Original Kettle Premium. We are so sorry to learn your experience did not match your expectations. We would suggest wearing a mitt to grip the ash catcher handle the first few times as it is tight, as time goes on this will become easier to accomplish. Our Support team will be reaching out to assist you further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Ash bin is thin, cheap crap. Very difficult to remove and replace
Results.Title: Should not have bought. The ash bin addition is ex

Results.ReviewText: I wanted a charcoal grill for my back patio. I bought this grill and it is working out as i expected. Even with the enclosed ash catcher, the grill gets enough air circulation to get hot enough to sear meat well. The only issue i had, and i won't dock a star for this, was during assembly one of the tabs didn't fit properly so the ring that holds the ash catcher didnt go on properly. I had some big linemans pliers, so i was able to bend the tab and get the grill together, but if you weren't comfortable "fixing" the tab, it would be an issue.
Results.Title: Good charcoal grill.

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
